sentence: In the state `in-hall`, when Guard Captain (captain) hears a sound (a line a character says is heard at once, as it is said), if what Guard Captain (captain) heard was a claim that failed and Guard Captain (captain) has noted `admitted` about the one Guard Captain (captain) heard (Guard Captain (captain) knows who only by seeing them), Guard Captain (captain) moves to the state `back-to-gate` (“an admitted guest lied to him”); the change and its reason reach every member of the run, wherever they are, whether or not they saw or heard what caused it.
